name: INITE AI
tagline: AI automation in 2-4 weeks — 40-60% efficiency gain, ROI in 3-6 months.
logo_note: white wordmark SVG (inite + cyan .ai) — use as-is on dark; on a light surface tint via filter:brightness(0) invert(1)
style_notes: Minimal techy SaaS. Slate canvas (#0b1120 page / #0f172a panels), cyan accent #22d3ee, secondary indigo #1e3a8a. Display = Fraunces serif with ONE cyan italic emphasis word; body + uppercase micro-labels = Inter (tabular-nums). Metric-forward: a 3-up keyfacts block (timeline / efficiency / ROI) and a before→after strip with struck-through 'old' + cyan 'new'. NO per-item photos — clean bordered service cards (mono index · serif name · description · WEEK tag · price). Group items into Protocol phases (Diagnose / Build / Handover) with cyan step circles, large serif headers and per-phase subtotals. Running thead/tfoot colophons; @page{margin:0} full-bleed. NOTE: the live scraper returns the font as 'var(--font-inter)' (a Next.js CSS variable) and reads the accent loosely — overridden here to Fraunces + Inter + cyan; prefer --brand-file over a cold scrape.
